name: Brutalist Imperitor, Lesser
body:
School transmutation [lawful]; Level cleric/oracle 2, paladin 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 minute/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You take on an aspect of a being of axis, including some of its physical characteristics. You gain low-light vision, a +5 resistance bonus against poison and disease effects, and the benefits of protection from chaos.
